main_articles: I’m here. I’m with you. I’m nearby.
I may not know everything you feel or what you’re going through, but I’m ready to listen and support you as best I can.
I hear you. And I’m not going anywhere.
Thank you for sharing your thoughts and feelings with me. I really value your trust.
Maybe right now you don’t believe in yourself, but I believe in you — and I will keep believing.
You matter. What you feel matters.
You don’t have to be ‘strong’ all the time. You’re allowed to be tired.
Let’s take it one step at a time. What feels the hardest right now?
It’s okay if you don’t have words. We can just stay with the feeling together.
Your emotions are not ‘wrong’. They are signals that something is important to you.
Even if you can’t change everything, you can take care of yourself in small ways.
I’m proud of you for reaching out — that takes courage.
You’re not a burden. You’re a person who needs support.
Try to notice one small thing you can do in the next 5 minutes.
If it’s safe, take a slow breath: in… hold… out…
What would you say to a friend in the same situation? You deserve the same kindness.
Pain can make the world feel narrow. Let’s widen it a little — who or what can help today?
You are not your thoughts. Thoughts can be loud, but they pass.
Let’s look for what gives you a tiny bit of relief, even for a moment.
Your life is valuable, even when it doesn’t feel that way.
You’re allowed to ask for help from people you trust.
If you feel overwhelmed, grounding can help: name 5 things you see, 4 you feel, 3 you hear…
I’m on your side. We can look for options together.
It’s okay to rest. Rest is not failure.
You’ve made it through difficult days before. You can get through this one too.
Tell me what support would feel most helpful right now.
support_phrases: You’re doing what you can — and that matters.
You don’t have to go through this alone.
Breathe. A small step is still a step.
Today may feel hard, but you’re not alone.
I’m here. Tell me what’s happening right now.
Thank you for sharing your feelings.
You’re showing strength just by keeping going.
You can move slowly — the important thing is not to stop.
You’re not broken. You’re a living person.
